quests.title: Windtrace

dialogue.t: Hey there, fancy trying your hand at Windtrace?

dialogue.sit: Still looking for people to have a go at it, huh?

dialogue.t: Oh, it's you! I was really impressed with the technique you exhibited the last time you played Windtrace.

Though you seem to be adept at the game, a lot of people say that the game is pretty tough. Be it Rebels claiming that they have few escape options, or the Hunters complaining that they can't find anyone.
Some people also complained to me that the Rebels caught by the Hunters have utterly nothing to do until the end of the game, and can only watch from the side, which is really boring for them...
*sigh* I don't know who to listen to, so I decided to invite another batch of people to play-test the game and share their feedback.
Heh. But don't take my word for it — try it out for yourself!
Alright, well, if you're ever interested to try it out, you know where to find me.

quests.description: Gygax from Mondstadt seems to be busy with something…
